On execution, the worker reads and locks the contract again, compares expected due date and sequence, and checks its current situation. An event scheduled before an edit cannot bill according to the old version. Redelivery finds an already processed cycle, and source keys on its documents prevent duplication.

Renewal preserves the historical start and calculates the new end from the previous end. Month arithmetic handles civil dates and month ends: in a non-leap year, a January 31 end can advance to February 28. Scheduling considers the store's business day and timezone. Automatic events use a system identity so the trail does not attribute a future renewal to someone who only edited the contract months earlier.

If a worker was stopped, the durable event still exists for processing. Execution continues to check eligibility and may find a suspended, terminated or already renewed contract. Cycle tests need to inspect generated documents and receivables, the next-billing pointer and retry behavior. The existence of this internal flow does not mean a gateway is charging the customer externally.

story.title: Seller and technician commissions
paragraphs: Sales and service orders share a commission ledger per line and beneficiary. A sale considers its seller; a service order considers its technicians. Posting freezes the net base, percentage, percentage source and release rule. Document discount is allocated across lines; freight and other additions stay outside the commissionable base. A later master-data change does not recalculate the past.

Commission can be released on financial generation, full payment of the first or last installment, or proportionally to principal received. Under the proportional rule, a R$100 base at 10% accrues R$10; if half the eligible principal was received, R$5 is released. Reversing that receipt makes the share pending again. Offsetting debt through a return does not count as money received.

Reconciliation runs inside the document transaction and records accruals and reversals with unique keys per source, line, beneficiary and cycle. Release is derived from settlements, avoiding a second balance that could become stale. With several technicians, a deterministic rule splits the base and allocates remaining cents. Even the absence of a usable percentage is frozen as policy so a future master-data edit cannot create retroactive commission.

A converted quote cannot earn commission simultaneously through two legacy destinations. Reconciliation uses a per-quote lock when deciding between documents. Reports group by beneficiary, document, product or service, respect account, store and currency, and support export. The module tracks entitlement and release; commission payment and payroll remain outside this control.

story.title: Service Desk and support history
paragraphs: Service Desk organizes tickets, assignees, categories, channels, comments and custom fields. A ticket can link a customer available in the store or record a manual requester. Channel and direction are separate: phone describes the medium; inbound or outbound describes who initiated contact. The center presents indicators and tickets within the authorized scope.

The account creates situation names and colors mapped to open, in progress, waiting for customer, resolved and closed behaviors. Moving between situations with the same behavior still records history without inventing another start or resolution. A situation referenced by tickets or history retains its behavior. Start, resolve and reopen actions retain defined destinations.

A transition carries the expected state and conflicts if another operator already changed the ticket. Creation and changes append immutable events in the same transaction. Requester contact is a snapshot: editing another field does not silently replace the recipient because the customer record changed. Internal notes and history observations remain internal; sending a public reply after resolution requires reopening the ticket.

Permission to edit a ticket does not grant every comment permission. The service locks the parent and persisted comments before classifying created, changed or removed content and enforcing the corresponding capability. The center summary uses an explicit field selection so complete relations cannot bring data from other resources. Concurrency tests observe competition for records and check that transitions and edits cannot leave inappropriate public content after closure.

story.title: Shared screens and extensions
paragraphs: Forms, tables, filters, pickers and actions are composed through shared metadata and contracts. Each module registers fields and adds interfaces for operations needing more context, such as converting a quote, closing a register or counting stock. Common infrastructure handles state, presentation and contract execution; commercial decisions stay in the domain that owns them.

Imports, exports, PDF, email, translation and themes share common paths. Contextual help, hints, checklists and tours use declared programs filtered by session modules and permissions. The same user can receive different guidance in two accounts or stores because the authorized context changed. The interface does not need a second copy of access rules to decide which actions to offer.

The extension SDK declares versioned manifests, contributions, commands and events. Validators check identifiers, dependencies, configuration and content. Event publication uses the existing unit of work and outbox; account and actor come from server context. The contract does not authorize loading arbitrary code or turn an extension declaration into a complete runtime.

The CRUD evolution preserved public signatures for over a hundred services while separating reads, field policy and scope. To investigate a commercial command, audit connects actor, transition and planned effects with records actually changed in stock and finance. A replay without effects creates no further success evidence. Domain tests, PostgreSQL integration tests and browser journeys check those boundaries; that infrastructure does not replace running and assessing each delivery's scenarios.

en.outcome: AuthSales brings commercial operations and their stock, financial and service effects onto shared infrastructure. Other systems can use the foundation, and the CRUD evolution preserved the public signatures of over a hundred services.
en.role: Responsible for architecture and full stack development: API, interface, data modeling, business rules and validation infrastructure.

decisions.title: One transaction for the document's effects
decisions.body: CrudUnitOfWork coordinates writes, audit, idempotency and outbox. Sale, purchase and service order adapters plan effects; stock and finance retain ownership of their postings. A failure rolls back the whole operation.

decisions.title: Authorization inside business rules
decisions.body: OperationContext and Data Scope resolve account, store and actor on the server. Sensitive commands check authorization and state again under a lock, covering calls that do not pass through the screen.

decisions.title: History through offsetting entries
decisions.body: Settlements, stock movements and commissions preserve the original facts. Reversing or cancelling appends records linked to their source, so the system can reconstruct what happened and recognize a replay.

decisions.title: Explicit money, quantity and time semantics
decisions.body: Financial calculations use decimals and exact cents; quantities respect units and conversions. Instants, civil dates, local times and durations have distinct contracts, so due dates and recurrence do not change with the process timezone.

decisions.title: Asynchronous work after commit
decisions.body: Persisted outbox events drive subsequent effects and scheduled cycles. Email and PDF queues use existing infrastructure. Each consumer must recognize redelivery; a queue alone does not guarantee a single execution.

decisions.title: Validation beyond the HTTP response
decisions.body: The repository has domain tests, PostgreSQL integration tests and Playwright journeys. Criteria include persisted balances, financial entries, history and isolation alongside API responses. Concurrency scenarios check what happens when two commands compete for the same record.

incident.title: Cancelling through a situation left the receivable open
incident.body: The situation dialog wrote through a different path from document editing. Cancelling a sale there could leave its receivable open. The architectural fix routed these commands through the same unit of work and posting boundary, with a document lock, transactional effects and an audit of the records actually changed.

limits: The current catalog includes commercial, finance, service orders and Service Desk. Fiscal is at pre-issuance, without validated transmission; projects, training, industrial, maintenance, facilities, quality, salon and document management remain outside the current launch.
External integration infrastructure and the SDK describe contracts. They do not, by themselves, represent operational bank connectors, payment gateway billing or fiscal issuance.
Commission tracking calculates and monitors entitlements and release; commission payments and payroll remain outside this module.

pt.title: Um checklist automático entre a nota fiscal e o ERP
pt.summary: Notas de fornecedores conferidas contra pedidos e contratos no momento em que chegam.
pt.problem: Notas de fornecedores eram conferidas à mão contra pedidos e contratos no ERP antes do lançamento.

how.title: Entrada flexível
how.body: XML por webhook ou em lote, com o tipo de documento identificado na chegada.

how.title: Exceções primeiro
how.body: Cancelamento e descarte encerram antes de qualquer conferência.

how.title: Checklist
how.body: Cerca de dez itens, e cada um grava se passou, falhou ou foi pulado.

how.title: Motivo legível
how.body: A nota sai com o motivo para quem vai tratar, não só com um status.

how.title: Regras de casos reais
how.body: Como saldo de pedido e fornecedor validado pelo emitente da nota.

en.title: An automatic checklist between the invoice and the ERP
en.summary: Supplier invoices checked against purchase orders and contracts the moment they arrive.
en.problem: Supplier invoices were checked by hand against purchase orders and contracts in the ERP before being posted.

how.title: Flexible intake
how.body: XML by webhook or in batches, with the document type identified on arrival.

how.title: Exceptions first
how.body: Cancellations and discards stop before any check runs.

how.title: Checklist
how.body: About ten items, each recording whether it passed, failed or was skipped.

how.title: A readable reason
how.body: Each invoice leaves with the reason for whoever handles it, not just a status.

how.title: Rules from real cases
how.body: Such as order balance and supplier validated by the invoice issuer.

en.outcome: Triage now happens on arrival, and the tax team only looks at what failed, reason included.

pt.title: Ordens de serviço e estoque para uma rede de oficinas
pt.summary: Cada oficina vê só o que é dela, e a contagem de estoque aponta onde o número não bate.
pt.problem: Uma rede de oficinas de pneus precisava de ordens de serviço e estoque por unidade, com a equipe de campo no celular e dados vindos de um sistema antigo.

how.title: Escopo por oficina
how.body: Cada unidade vê apenas as próprias ordens de serviço.

how.title: Busca por medida
how.body: Pneus cadastrados e buscados por medida, e entradas validadas antes de gravar.

how.title: Contagem de estoque
how.body: Aponta a divergência entre o contado e o esperado.

how.title: Migração
how.body: Tabelas do sistema antigo levadas para a nova estrutura, com as sequências reajustadas.

pt.outcome: As oficinas passaram a trabalhar no mesmo sistema, cada uma com seus dados, e as diferenças de estoque aparecem na contagem.

en.title: Work orders and stock for a network of workshops
en.summary: Each workshop sees only its own data, and stock counts point out where the numbers don't match.
en.problem: A network of tire workshops needed work orders and stock per location, with a field team on their phones and data coming from an old system.

how.title: Per-workshop scope
how.body: Each location sees only its own work orders.

how.title: Search by size
how.body: Tires registered and searched by size, and receiving validated before it is saved.

how.title: Stock counts
how.body: They point out the gap between what was counted and what was expected.

how.title: Android app
how.body: For the field team, with file uploads and work order notifications.

how.title: Migration
how.body: The old system's tables moved to the new structure, with sequences reset.

en.outcome: The workshops now work in the same system, each with its own data, and stock differences show up in the count.

pt.title: Contas a pagar sincronizadas com um ERP em nuvem
pt.summary: Um painel financeiro para várias empresas de um grupo, com títulos agrupados por nota e sincronização com o ERP.
pt.problem: O financeiro de várias empresas de um grupo lançava contas num ERP em nuvem, com cadastros espalhados e uma API com limites e lentidão.

how.title: Sincronização por empresa
how.body: Categorias, contas bancárias, clientes, fornecedores, ordens de serviço e contratos.

how.title: Lotes de 50
how.body: Consultas ao ERP em lotes, com pausa entre eles, para respeitar os limites da API.

how.title: Agrupados por nota
how.body: Baixa e estorno de títulos refletidos no ERP.

how.title: Sem duplicidade
how.body: Checagem antes da baixa, e exclusão de agrupamento só com justificativa registrada.

how.title: Painéis
how.body: Recebimentos e saídas de contas a pagar.

pt.outcome: Os lançamentos passaram a nascer no painel e chegar ao ERP sem retrabalho, com registro de quem excluiu o quê e por quê.

en.title: Accounts payable in sync with a cloud ERP
en.summary: A finance panel for several companies in a group, with bills grouped by invoice and synced with the ERP.
en.problem: The finance team of several companies in one group posted bills in a cloud ERP, with scattered master data and a slow, rate-limited API.

how.title: Per-company sync
how.body: Categories, bank accounts, customers, suppliers, work orders and contracts.

how.title: Batches of 50
how.body: ERP queries in batches with a pause between them, to respect the API limits.

how.title: Grouped by invoice
how.body: Settling and reversing bills is reflected in the ERP.

how.title: No duplicates
how.body: A check before settling, and group deletion only with a recorded justification.

how.title: Dashboards
how.body: Incoming payments and outgoing payables.

en.outcome: Entries now start in the panel and reach the ERP without rework, with a record of who deleted what and why.
